The raid was launched ten minutes ago.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Pellaeon]] and [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]]|<ref name="Last Command" />}}
The '''Second Battle of Nomad City''' was a raid launched by [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] to supply his [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] in the [[Bilbringi system/Legends|Bilbringi system]] with much-needed [[hfredium]] and [[Kammris/Legends|kammris]].

==The battle==
Thrawn sent three [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Dreadnaught''-class heavy cruisers]] to acquire them; after cutting off communications in [[Nomad City]], and disabling both the city and its accompanying [[shieldship]]s, Thrawn received large amounts of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and four months worth of supplies.

==Aftermath==
The mobile city was disabled, and was unable to get away from the oncoming and deadly sunrise of [[Nkllon/Legends|Nkllon]]. However, the [[Peregrine (Dreadnaught-class)|''Peregrine'']] arrived, commanded by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]]. Bel Iblis' forces helped evacuate the citizens of Nomad City. Bel Iblis and [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] asked Admiral [[Hiram Drayson/Legends|Hiram Drayson]] to lend part of his fleet to save the city, but Drayson refused. Nomad City was nevertheless rescued and repaired, only for Lando to lose it in a Sabacc game.
